Clay is pinned so the native game builds without fetching a UI layout dependency. Its upstream license is retained.

| Library | Official source | Revision | Archive SHA-256 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Clay | https://github.com/nicbarker/clay | `b25a31c1a152915cd7dd6796e6592273e5a10aac` (`v0.14`) | `1cba69296adf4efb57dbabc46076f0d50912319ed703d372c655e6a45c47129d` |

Clay resolves the current HUD, Shop and dialog layout. SDL and SDL_ttf draw the game artwork and text. Dear ImGui was removed with the obsolete Studio editor.
